summary: plan.json validates structurally (1 phase, 1 task) but does not cover the approved brief/design: AC8-AC11 are absent, outputs do not match the design's file layout, and the phase criteria use wrong AC numbering.

criteria.notes: Plan covers AC1-AC7 only. Brief requires AC1-AC11 (R6 persistence, AC9 bind host, AC10 log privacy, AC11 test coverage).

criteria.description: Owner, deps, inputs, outputs, file ownership, acceptance, verification
criteria.notes: Fields present, but outputs list 3 files while design lists file-repository.js, validate.js, identity.js, body.js, logger.js, service.js, app.js and 8 test files. Verification 'node --test' does not state which tests prove which AC.

Phase criteria say 'AC7: automated tests cover AC1-AC6', which contradicts the brief (AC7 is limits, AC11 is test coverage). One monolithic task gives no intermediate verifiable steps; design Implementation Workflow has 3 steps with parallelism.

findings.title: AC8-AC11 not planned
findings.detail: Durable file persistence (AC8, RISK-2 high), loopback bind and warning (AC9, RISK-1 high), log privacy (AC10) and the AC11 coverage criterion are not in any task's acceptance criteria.
findings.recommendation: Add AC8-AC11 to task and phase acceptance criteria. Resolved when every AC1-AC11 appears in a task and the phase.

findings.title: Outputs and file ownership do not match design
findings.detail: Design specifies src/file-repository.js etc. and tests persistence/security/limits/logging/api; plan lists only server.js, store.js, notes.test.js. Ownership globs would allow it but outputs are not verifiable against the design.
findings.recommendation: List the design's modules and test files as outputs, optionally split into tasks following the design's Implementation Workflow with dependencies. Resolved when outputs map to the design.

findings.title: Wrong AC numbering in phase criteria
findings.detail: 'AC7: automated tests cover AC1-AC6' conflicts with brief where AC7 is size/note limits and AC11 is test coverage.
findings.recommendation: Restate phase criteria as AC1-AC11 using the brief's numbering.

findings.title: Verification should map to AC traceability matrix
findings.detail: Single 'node --test' command; design says CI must fail if a test file is missing.
findings.recommendation: Reference the matrix and name required test files in verification.
